sections.heading: C2 — KG hints for Rural, Night, Sharing, Weather
sections.markdown:
## C2 — KG hints for Rural, Night, Sharing, Weather

FACT_ID: sec16-R01 | anchor: A01
On narrow gravel roads in rural areas, reduce speed and keep as far right as safety allows when meeting traffic. Approach narrow bridges cautiously and be ready to stop for an oncoming vehicle because some bridges can carry only one vehicle at once. [A01]
Why it matters: group_hint rural; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec16-F01 and sec16-F02.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec16-R02 | anchor: A01
Hills and curves pre-slow rightward, while bare rural crossings double-look and ready stops [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint rural; prereq_hint sec16-F01; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec16-F03 and sec16-F04.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec16-R03 | anchor: A01
Creeping farm and work traffic gets early spotting, while night wants low beams, long gaps, and stripe tracking [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint rural-night; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec16-F05 and sec16-F06.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec16-R04 | anchor: A02
Surprise animals hold course unswerved, while deer peaks span fall months plus May [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint animals; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec16-F07 and sec16-F08.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec16-R05 | anchor: A02
Car riders take truck-crash deaths mostly, while no-zones ring rigs on three sides [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint trucks; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec16-F09.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec16-R06 | anchor: A02
Passes return past mirror-full noses, while right turns swing left past curb squeezers [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint trucks; prereq_hint sec16-F09; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec16-F10 and sec16-F11.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec16-R07 | anchor: A03
Bikes earn space, intersection care, and signal distrust, while trails gap three-plus seconds [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint motorcycles; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec16-F12 and sec16-F13.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0058]

FACT_ID: sec16-R08 | anchor: A03
Crossings scan for wheels and feet with yields, while stopped cars for walkers never get passed [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint peds; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec16-F14 and sec16-F15.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0058]

FACT_ID: sec16-R09 | anchor: A03
Bicycles take full lanes on passes, while nights and right turns double-watch them [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint bicycles; prereq_hint sec16-F14; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec16-F16 and sec16-F17.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0058]

FACT_ID: sec16-R10 | anchor: A04
Never leave a child, an older person, a dependent person or a pet alone inside an enclosed vehicle. Depending on heat and humidity, the cabin can exceed one hundred sixty degrees in under ten minutes; even a seventy-eight-degree day can raise the interior to one hundred degrees in minutes. Iowa permits breaking a vehicle window to give medical attention to a trapped person or animal. [A04]
Why it matters: group_hint hot-car; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec16-F18.
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec16-R11 | anchor: A04
Trips pre-study traveler info and cams, while forced storm runs slow, gap, kill cruise, and pack kits [A04].
Why it matters: group_hint weather-prep; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec16-F19 and sec16-F20.
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec16-R12 | anchor: A05
Wet wants wipers, low beams, five-plus gaps, and dead cruise, while planing water outslicks tread [A05].
Why it matters: group_hint wet; prereq_hint sec16-F20; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec16-F21 and sec16-F22.
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec16-R13 | anchor: A05
Floods float trucks in inches and ban crossings, while fog bans high beams and tornadoes rank watches below warnings [A05].
Why it matters: group_hint hazards; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec16-F23 and sec16-F25.
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec16-R14 | anchor: A06
Snow strips cars bare and black ice ambushes bridges first, while launches stay straight and gentle [A06].
Why it matters: group_hint winter; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec16-F28 and sec16-F29.
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec16-R15 | anchor: A06
Plows plod near 30 mph with wide berths, while stranding stays belted inside and phones out [A06].
Why it matters: group_hint winter; prereq_hint sec16-F28; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec16-F30 and sec16-F31.
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0061]
